sql:
SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
FROM (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
          SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage_Increase
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
ORDER BY Percentage_Increase DESC

sql:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customer_count
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
averages AS (
  SELECT Segment, total_consumption / customer_count AS annual_average
  FROM totals
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
  (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS "SME-LAM",
  (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
  (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS "LAM-KAM",
  (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
  (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS "KAM-SME"

sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN inpatient_count > outpatient_count THEN 'in-patient'
    WHEN outpatient_count > inpatient_count THEN 'outpatient'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS group_with_more_males,
  (CAST(inpatient_count AS REAL) / outpatient_count - 1) * 100 AS deviation_percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(Admission = '+') AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(Admission = '-') AS outpatient_count
  FROM Patient

)

sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.ID = 57266
    AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5))
) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

sql:
WITH extremes AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, player_name
  FROM Player
  WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
  UNION
  SELECT player_api_id, player_name
  FROM Player
  WHERE height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
)
SELECT e.player_name
FROM extremes AS e
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = e.player_api_id
GROUP BY e.player_api_id, e.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(pa.finishing) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT f.name
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND f.language = 'Italian'
  AND c.convertedManaCost = (

    JOIN sets AS s2 ON s2.code = c2.setCode

  )

sql:
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count)
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN a.atom_id END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)

WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0

sql:
SELECT CAST(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5

)

WHERE score_rank <= 5

WITH ratings AS (
  SELECT p.player_name, pa.overall_rating,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY p.player_api_id
           ORDER BY pa.date DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM Player AS p
  JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
)
SELECT
  (CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN overall_rating END) AS REAL)
   - MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END)) * 100
   / MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END)
FROM ratings
WHERE rn = 1

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)

ORDER BY s.City
